title: Kimi K3 (2.8T) at 1 token/s on a MacBook Pro, streamed from four SSDs
summary: This content discusses running the massive Kimi K3 (2.8T parameter) model on a MacBook Pro at 1 token/s by streaming weights from four SSDs, likely via a custom framework (DeltaFin). It highlights extreme memory optimization and I/O-bound inference, pushing the limits of local deployment for frontier-scale LLMs.
